title: ANDS Studio — Guided submission journey
walkthrough:
You land on a hero headed "File your ANDS with Health Canada — guided end to end." A paragraph explains that an Abbreviated New Drug Submission is a complex filing this walks you through step by step, keeping the regulatory vocabulary precise. The primary button reads "Start my submission →." Below it, two chips offer "Managing several products? Open the dossier catalog" (with a count when dossiers exist) and "Portfolio roll-up" (which appends "· N in progress" when any are blocked). A quieter line notes bilingual Module 1 and the EN + FR Product Monograph live inside each dossier.

A "Trust & security" strip follows, headed "the questions your auditor asks first — answered plainly," listing four live pillars — data residency, tenant isolation, roles and segregation of duties, audit-trail tamper controls — each with a one-line summary, plus one pillar chip-marked "roadmap" (SOC 2 / SSO / SCIM). A fuller "One-page security summary" sits behind an expander. A footer says your progress is saved automatically.

On a first visit you may instead see a gate titled "Two things Health Canada must issue you," listing the 5-digit Company ID (lead time ~2 weeks) and the permanent Dossier ID (issued on request via REP), each with an explanation, a source citation and an "HC guidance ↗" link. A button reads "I understand — begin the journey →" and is remembered.

After starting, the screen splits into three columns. On the left, "Your filing journey" is a numbered rail: the current step says "You're here," done steps show a check, later steps show a lock with a plain-language reason. A mode toggle sits top-right — switching to Expert mode makes locked steps navigable but marked "not yet recommended" instead of blocked.

The centre column is the active step card, with an eyebrow like "Step 1 of 10," the title, a one-line purpose, and a teaching paragraph where regulatory terms are dashed-underlined and reveal plain meanings on hover. The first step includes a "Tell me about your drug" panel (drug, filing type, dosage form, new-use checkbox) and a "Check my pathway" button. Later steps collect a Company ID, then a Dossier ID and product type, applicant and drug-product details, then document assembly, validation, fees, review, signing, transmission, and tracking. Each ends with a primary button and a "Next:" pointer.

The right column tracks readiness. A "Submission tower" stacks Modules 1–5, with a "3D view / Checklist" toggle. Below it, a "Readiness" card carries a "● READY TO FILE" or "● BLOCKED" badge and shows two tiers: a "Filing checklist" line (steps complete, percentage, progress bar) and a distinct "eCTD technical validation" verdict, noting it runs against a named ruleset with version and sync date and is "not HC's official eValidator; run eValidator before you transmit," with a "Rule catalogue" expander. Another expander asks "How is [x]% measured?" A "The single thing standing between you and ready" section names any blocker with a jump button. When a Dossier ID exists, an "Audit trail" card points to an append-only Part-11 ledger, exportable as CSV.

The top bar shows "guided ANDS filing," a "Ready to file" or "[x]% ready" chip, and a "Reset session" button that opens a typed-RESET confirmation noting your work is recoverable from version history.
